_help: sea lanes for terrain 6 (English Channel). ports: anchor = the water point where a ship waits off the port
(defaults to the scene position - MOVE IT ONTO WATER); approach = waypoints leading OUT of the anchor to open sea, in order.
lanes: from/to = port scene indices, points = open-sea waypoints from the end of from.approach to the end of to.approach
(a lane is used in both directions). Console: ship ports <room>, ship sail <onum> <from> <to> [mps].
